d: Indian stock markets have surged to an eight-month high, with the Sensex and Nifty gaining nearly 10% so far this month. The rally marks a dramatic turnaround after two years of foreign investors pulling money out of Indian equities. In this video, Firstpost examines what is driving the reversal. From growing concerns over massive artificial intelligence investments and stronger-than-expected corporate earnings to easing crude oil prices, three key factors are bringing global money back to Dalal Street. The video also looks at the rupee’s recovery, fresh foreign investment in government…
